name: Altclut
text: Altclut is another spelling of the old name of the rock of the Clyde on the west of Scotland. The form belongs to the same group as the name of the stronghold at Dumbarton. MacKiel includes the word in the set for the fortress on the Clyde.

attributes.attribute: old name of the fortress on the Clyde
